answer: With a Verified email inbox bound by challenge-response signature with a ninety-day rotation cooldown, the account is only as strong as its binding: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The record keeps every crystal visible, so anyone can audit the binding roll. The ridge test catches the lazy fake and the pearl test catches the patient one.
